memory.summary:
On December 21st, Mei meets up with Peter at a museum to discuss their AI project, community garden plans, and zine club discussions. They decide to grab dinner next week at Caroline's Café for further discussion. Mei, Andy, Diego, and others add these arrangements to their updated schedules.

Mei has several conversations throughout the day. At a restaurant around 8 AM, she discusses the AI project with Diego who suggests incorporating music into the project with Samantha and Noor. They arrange a meeting at Caroline's Café this coming Tuesday, December 21st, at 3 PM.

Later in the day, Mei has a catch-up with Caroline at her café regarding their AI project collaboration. They set up another meeting for the same day at 4 PM and plan another get-together at the café on Tuesday. Furthermore, Caroline promises to have Mei's favorite latte ready for their discussions.

At Caroline's Café around 12 PM, Mei talks to Noor about the AI project, zine club collaboration, and shares new musical ideas. They discuss meeting again next week, December 14th, after their usual session at the café to collaborate on both projects.

Additionally, Mei has a conversation with Caroline at the library around 2 PM where they discuss sketches for the zine club and share new musical ideas. They agree to catch up over coffee before their community garden meeting next week at 2 PM, also at Caroline's Café. The summary now includes additional conversations between Mei, Diego, Noor, and Caroline, revolving around the AI project, music collaboration, zine club, and future meetings at Caroline's Café.
